seed_note: Proposed outer replay seed only. Its specific geode positions/counts have not been sampled by the author and are not asserted.

initial_conditions.origin: Unmodified candidate.reset(key), with the complete specified mirror-pair distribution
initial_conditions.geode_status: All eight buried at whatever locations this actual reset produces.

intended_objectives: Move both role pairs through real map cells.
Obtain near scans with actual private counts, then exchange at true adjacency.
Dig soil cells [4,5] and [8,5] while surveyors make far scans from their current positions.
Rendezvous to share post-dig measurements, then recharge surveyors on their own base approaches.

conditional_events.condition: A sampled buried geode actually occupies a soil cell that reaches depth two. No such placement is assumed from seed 17.

limitations: Unexecuted fixed script; no actual legality, scan count, discovery, score, victory or animation is claimed.
The script does not pick or shove based on unobserved placement and does not demonstrate every implemented mechanism.
